total_model.summary: Model projects 47.9 total points (DAL 27, PHI 21). Biggest factors: Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.1), Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.9), Divisional game (lowers total 0.8). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
